interval_caveat: the count is exact and deterministic; the interval covers sampling variance only. These pairs are hand-authored, not drawn at random from any population, so the interval says nothing about how representative the corpus is (docs/CALIBRATION.md)
name: matcher_false_positive_rate_on_structured_language
what_a_pair_is: two calls in flight at once, from the same family, sharing language structure and no information. A false positive is the matcher finding a k-gram of one call's arguments in the other call's request
